summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. The 41 tests in the new module plus test/test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed, and no other files changed. Not verified: black, isort, and mypy (not installed in the venv), so formatting, import order, and the type-ignore comments are unchecked.
